 North Dakota’s Minimum Wage to Remain the Same
 by 
 Paul Bougie 
 November 19, 2026 
 North Dakota News , Top Stories 
 (Bismarck, ND) — North Dakota is not following in our neighbor’s footsteps next year when both South Dakota and Montana raise their minimum wage. North Dakota’s minimum wage remains at seven-dollars-25-cents an hour, the same rate workers have had since July of 2009. South Dakota’s minimum wage is set to increase by 45-cents an hour, from eleven-dollars-85-cents to 12-dollars-30-cents. Montana is raising their rate from ten-dollars-85-cents to eleven-dollars-20-cents an hour.
